summary: Iteration 9 — Regression for admin_education category split into admin_consulting + education. Backend: 5/5 pytest passing (/app/backend/tests/test_category_split.py, JUnit at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_iter9_category_split.xml). GET /api/categories returns exactly one admin_consulting ('Administrative Consultants') and one education ('Education (Private Tutoring)') entry, admin_education is gone. GET /api/providers?category=admin_consulting returns Leila Bensalem with category='admin_consulting'. GET /api/providers?category=education returns Nassim Bouzid with category='education'. GET /api/providers?category=admin_education returns []. Mongo direct check: db.users.count_documents({category:'admin_education'}) == 0 (migration succeeded). Frontend (Playwright, 390×844, http://localhost:3000): guest flow Onboarding → Continue as guest → Home chip strip shows both new chips with correct testIDs cat-chip-admin_consulting and cat-chip-education, no legacy cat-chip-admin_education, no 'Admin Education' text on the screen. Tapping the Education chip reloads the provider list and shows Nassim Bouzid card; tapping Administrative Consultants shows Leila Bensalem. Localized labels verified in all 3 languages: EN 'Administrative Consultants' / 'Education (Private Tutoring)', FR 'Consultants administratifs' / 'Éducation (cours particuliers)', AR 'استشاريون إداريون' / 'التعليم (دروس خصوصية)'. Old Arabic string 'دعم إداري وتعليمي' is absent from the home screen in Arabic mode.
critical_code_review_comments: One-shot migration in server.py updates rows where category='admin_education' → 'admin_consulting' on startup; both Leila (admin_consulting) and Nassim (education) are seeded directly with the new keys, so no legacy rows remain. Idempotent.
cat-chip testIDs are derived from category id (`cat-chip-${c.id}`); adding new categories in the future does not require testID changes.
